review_candidates.title: Junior Operations and Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: TotalEnergies Renewables is looking for a Junior Operations and Maintenance Engineer in Zhambyl region, Kazakhstan. M-Kat Green Project. Activities Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Participate in the planning and execution of annual, monthly, and weekly O&M plans. Monitor compliance with generation schedules and equipment availability. Coordinate the work of technicians, contractors, and service providers. Participate in equipment start-ups, shutdowns, switching operations, and operating mode changes. Maintain records of equipment failures, defects, incidents, and operational deviations. Monitor the quality of maintenance and repair activities. Participate in incident investigations and the development of corrective actions. Ensure the availability and proper condition of tools, equipment, and spare parts. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Perform plant performance forecasting and data analysis. Monitor the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by employees and contractors. Participate in the development and delivery of safety briefings, ensure compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS), industrial safety, fire safety, and electrical safety requirements, and monitor adherence to these requirements by personnel. Participate in employee training and induction programs. Liaise with Operations, HSE, HR, Procurement, and Finance departments. Maintain effective working relationships with Contractors, Suppliers, stakeholders (KEGOC, REC, etc.), and government authorities. Participate in the process of obtaining the Autumn-Winter Readiness Certificate. Achieve objectives within the Annual Individual Review (AIR) and Individual Results (IR) performance evaluation framework. Ensure the timely execution of planned preventive maintenance (PPM) activities in accordance with approved schedules and maintenance plans. Monitor the technical condition of equipment and organize and coordinate the elimination of identified faults, defects, and observations until full closure. HSE Ensure that all work performed on site complies with applicable health, safety, fire protection, electrical safety regulations, and other relevant requirements, as well as local instructions and procedures. Periodically pass examinations and obtain certifications in accordance with electrical safety, fire safety, and occupational health requirements. Participate in safety inductions, training sessions, and competency assessments related to occupational health and safety, industrial safety, fire safety, and electrical safety. Conduct ongoing monitoring to ensure employees comply with HSE requirements, company internal procedures, and applicable occupational health and industrial safety legislation. Ensure compliance with environmental protection requirements, monitor the implementation of the company's environmental procedures, and participate in activities aimed at preventing environmental pollution and minimizing environmental risks at the site. Comply with the established work and rest schedule and promote a healthy balance between work responsibilities and personal time to support employee safety, well-being, and sustainable productivity (Work-Life Balance). Finance As the designated financial custodian, ensure the proper storage, control, and utilization of inventory and spare parts, and prepare monthly inventory usage reports. Participate in annual inventory counts and asset verification activities. Contribute to the preparation of the annual budget (BU) and Long-Term Plan (LTP). Participate in the development and preparation of the Procurement Plan. Maintain and monitor expenditure records within the Contract Management and Cost Management registers. Context and environment The position is responsible for supporting the operation and maintenance of a utility-scale PV power plant in accordance with company policies, HSE requirements, contractual obligations, and regulatory standards. The role requires frequent interaction with internal departments, contractors, suppliers, and external stakeholders to ensure safe operations, high plant availability, and achievement of production targets. Work is performed in both office and field environments and may require participation in emergency response and outage management activities when required. Purpose Ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the site, coordinating maintenance activities, and supporting operational management. Qualifications / Experience required • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (electrical power engineering, automation, or a related field). • At least 2 years of work experience in the energy sector or renewable energy. • Knowledge of the principles of operating solar power plants and electrical equipment. • Proficiency in Excel and data analysis skills. • Fluent in Russian; English proficiency at the Intermediate level or higher. Knowledge of Kazakh is a plus. • Skills in working with technical documentation and reporting. Competencies in: • Electric power industry legislation. • Safety regulations for the operation of electrical installations. • Technical operating regulations for power plants and grids. • Regulations governing the installation of electrical systems. • Fire safety and first aid. • Communication, accountability, leadership potential, and teamwork. • ST RK 2776-2015, Requirements for Testing Electrical Equipment Upon Commissioning and During Operation.

review_candidates.title: ソフトウェアエンジニア／データエンジニア
review_candidates.description: 【初期メンバー募集】製造現場のデータ分断を解消し、AIを現場の力に！株式会社Industry Xで2つのエンジニアポジションを同時募集します！ 株式会社Industry Xでは、製造現場の意思決定を支援する新規プロダクトを開発中です。 現在は新規開発フェーズにあり、プロダクトのコアを一緒に創り上げるエンジニアを募集しています！ ★私たちのチームカルチャー（全ポジション共通） 一次情報に触れるフットワーク: 開発するシステムは「本当に現場で使われるもの」であるべきという考えから、自社工場へ足を運び、ホワイトボードや実際のオペレーションを直接見に行くことを重視します。 不確実性を楽しむ: 仕様が完全に決まっていない状態から、現場と対話して要件を自ら提案し形にしていくことを面白がれる環境です。 透明性の高いコミ ュニケーション : 少人数チームだからこそ、分からないことを素直に言え、共に課題解決に向き合えるオープンさを大切にしています。 ※製造業のドメイン知識は不問です（業務知識は社内でしっかりサポートします！） 今回、以下の2つのポジションで募集を行っています。 ポジション1：データエンジニア 「散在する汚いデータを、意味のある繋がりに変える」プロフェッショナル ミッション : 「設備・工程・原価」等の分断されたデータを一つのデータ基盤として構築し、DWH等へ格納・出力できる状態を作ります。 主な業務 : 複数システムからのデータ収集・統合、表記揺れ吸収や紐付けルールの作成（クレンジング）、データパイプライン設計・運用、データベース設計・モデリング。 必須スキル : Pythonによるデータ処理実務（3年以上）、ETL/ELTパイプライン設計・運用経験、SQL抽出・集計経験、データモデリングの基礎・実務経験。 歓迎スキル : クラウド（AWS, GCP, Azure等）でのパイプライン構築経験。 ※パズルを解くような根気や泥臭いデータ整理を楽しめる方を歓迎します！ 想定年収 : 600万円〜850万円 ※ご経験・スキルに応じて決定。上記超の条件も個別相談可 ポジション2：ソフトウェアエンジニア 「AIの提案を人が使える形にし、判断を記録に変える」アプリケーション開発 ミッション : AIが分析した結果をダッシュボード等に出力し、ユーザーが確認・判断・記録できる一連のアプリケーションフローを構築します。 主な業務 : LLM等AI APIの呼び出し機能実装、不確実なAI出力をシステムとして安全に受け止める設計、Pythonでのバックエンド（API）開発、React/TypeScriptでのフロントエンド開発。 必須スキル : Pythonを用いたバックエンドAPI開発経験（FastAPI等）、React, TypeScriptを用いたフロントエンド開発経験。 ※「完璧に動く前提」ではなく「不確実なものを設計で受け止める力」を重視します。 歓迎スキル : データモデリングやSQL経験、LLM APIやGraphRAGを組み込んだアプリ開発経験など。 想定年収 : 550万円〜850万円 ※ご経験・スキルに応じて決定。上記超の条件も個別相談可 具体的なプロダクトの詳細については、選考の場でお話しさせていただきます！ 「ゼロイチの開発を楽しみたい」「データやAIを泥臭く現場の価値に繋げたい」という方、ぜひお気軽にご応募ください。お待ちしております！

review_candidates.title: Tier I Technical Support Specialist — Smart Cooler Vending
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tier I Technical Support Specialist — Smart Cooler Vending based in Estonia. This is a fully remote technical support role focused on helping operators successfully run smart cooler vending equipment. You will serve as the first point of contact for technical questions involving connected machines, mobile apps, payment readers, and basic connectivity issues. The role combines customer communication, structured troubleshooting, technical information gathering, and detailed documentation. You will help customers with onboarding, machine-status concerns, app-related questions, transaction issues, and approved first-line troubleshooting. You will work closely with a Tier II technical team, providing clean and complete handoffs whenever deeper diagnosis or technical decisions are required. Success in this role depends on being organized, technically curious, customer-focused, and comfortable following defined support processes. This is an opportunity to build hands-on experience with smart vending technology, connected devices, payment systems, and real-world technical support. Accountabilities Customer Support Intake: Receive and respond to technical support requests through approved channels, identify the issue category, gather relevant customer and machine information, and determine the likely area involved, such as the mobile app, backend, physical equipment, POS, payment reader, or connectivity. Issue Documentation: Capture machine IDs, models, locations, timelines, error messages, screenshots, videos, troubleshooting history, and customer impact, including downtime, lost sales, failed transactions, or installation delays. Basic Troubleshooting: Guide customers through approved first-line troubleshooting procedures, including app checks, remote restarts, physical power cycles, and other documented steps. Monitor whether issues remain resolved and identify recurring offline events or transactions stuck in processing. Onboarding Support: Assist customers with routine setup and onboarding, app navigation, product libraries, pricing, templates, inventory, machine management, and preparation for technical-support sessions. Provide clear follow-up summaries and direct customers to approved training and knowledge resources. Connectivity Information Gathering: Collect the information required for deeper technical investigation, including whether equipment uses cellular, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or a router; available facility IT support; physical signal limitations; and requested screenshots, speed-test results, photos, or status information. Payment & Transaction Support: Help identify whether transaction issues appear to originate within the application environment or payment ecosystem. Gather transaction dates, times, amounts, machine IDs, and supporting evidence before escalating issues involving payment readers, settlements, integrations, or other advanced payment concerns. Customer Communication & Follow-Up: Communicate calmly and professionally, acknowledge customer concerns, ask focused questions, explain technical steps in accessible language, provide realistic next steps, and maintain consistent communication throughout the support process. Escalation & Handoffs: Recognize when an issue exceeds the approved Tier I process and escalate it with a complete, structured handoff so the Tier II team can continue the investigation without repeating the initial diagnostic process. Support Records: Maintain accurate records of every troubleshooting step, customer response, outcome, and escalation status while clearly distinguishing confirmed facts from assumptions. Requirements Customer Support Experience: 1–3 years of relevant experience in technical support, customer support, help desk, field-service coordination, or a similar customer-facing environment. Technical Foundation: Basic understanding of smart devices, mobile applications, web dashboards, connected equipment, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, cellular connectivity, routers, and SIM-based connectivity. Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to follow structured troubleshooting checklists carefully, investigate symptoms methodically, recognize different types of machine, application, backend, POS, and payment-reader issues, and avoid skipping required steps. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical instructions into clear, simple language for non-technical customers. Documentation: Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately record customer information, machine details, symptoms, timelines, evidence, troubleshooting actions, and outcomes. Customer Mindset: Calm, patient, professional, and empathetic when supporting frustrated customers or situations involving downtime, failed transactions, or operational disruption. Judgment & Escalation: Comfortable acknowledging when an issue is outside your expertise and escalating it appropriately rather than guessing or making unsupported recommendations.
